title: Conditional choice for auxiliary counters
statement: For natural numbers $a$ and $j$, a Boolean $s$, and symbols $A,B\in\mathrm{AW}$, let $v_{a,j}$ assign the values $a$, $a+1$, $0$, $1$, $j$, and $j+1$ to the six symbols $ac$, $an$, $a0$, $a1$, $aj$, and $aj1$, respectively. Then $v_{a,j}$ of the symbol chosen as $A$ when $s$ is true and $B$ otherwise equals $v_{a,j}(A)$ when $s$ is true and $v_{a,j}(B)$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: a and j are natural numbers
A and B are auxiliary-counter symbols
